verdict.rationale: Factory Missions let a user 'work with Droid to define features, milestones, and success criteria before any code is written' (factory-docs-22, factory-docs-11), which maps loosely to turning an intent into a structured task with scope, and Jira/Linear integrations (factory-docs-4, factory-docs-26) could route such tasks into PM workflows. However there is no evidence of ingesting raw 'user feedback submissions' specifically or producing a PM-facing structured ticket/scope artifact from feedback text. Missing for 10: explicit feedback-intake mechanism, PM-oriented task/scope templates, and any demonstrated feedback-to-task conversion example.
